title: Azarashi report JSON v1
description: One decoded report. The contract is specified in docs/json.md; serialization API is separate.
$comment: Patterns end with $(?![\s\S]) rather than $, because in some regular expression engines, Python's among them, $ also matches before a trailing newline. Constraints a schema cannot express, a lower bound below its upper one, a semi-minor axis below its semi-major, a page number within its total, are checked by the conversion tests instead.

prn.$comment: the PRN number as transmitted, whose width leaves room for numbers QZSS has not assigned

envelope.description: What every record carries. nmea is required by the report types that have a QZQSM sentence, which is every type of this version.

azimuth_deg.$comment: A16 and EX7 count from -90 degrees; the centre bounds differ per group and are set there

ellipse.description: WGS84 centre; azimuth measured from east toward north, not a navigation bearing. source holds the transmitted codes of the group this ellipse comes from.

allOf.$comment: C1 to C4 add up to seven eighths of an A12 or A13 step, which can pass the pole or the meridian

hazard_centre.$comment: C5 and C6 offset the main centre by up to ten degrees either way

second_ellipse.description: CAMF B3 relative ellipse parameters; bearing convention is defined by CAMF C9.

page.$comment: both are six-bit fields as transmitted; a page number of zero is one the specification leaves undefined

allOf.$comment: A12 spans the poles and A13 the meridians
EX4 counts from 45 degrees east, so it passes 180
